heading: Wisconsin DHS Issues Seasonal Immunization Recommendations
summary: The Department of Health Services released its recommendations for the respiratory virus season. The guidance covers influenza, COVID-19 and RSV vaccination for eligible people. The release also describes standing medical orders the agency issued to improve access to flu and COVID-19 vaccination.

heading: Wisconsin Announces $1.3 Million in Coastal Grants
source: Wisconsin Department of Administration press release
summary: State officials announced $1.3 million in grants for coastal communities. The announcement came at the close of Coastal Awareness Month. The state also said applications for the next grant round were open through November 3.
